title: In, on and at: free practice
titleEs: In, on y at: práctica libre
instructionEs: Escribe, transforma y corrige las frases.

items.text: I always drink coffee ___ the morning.
items.explanationEs: Partes del día: in the morning, in the afternoon, in the evening.
Lugar donde se hace una actividad: at school, at work.

items.text: There is a picture ___ the wall.
items.explanationEs: Sobre una superficie, también vertical: on the wall.

answers: The museum doesn't open on Monday.
items.explanationEs: Negativa en presente simple: doesn't + open.

items.source: The shop is on the corner.
answers: Is the shop on the corner?
items.explanationEs: Pregunta con to be: is antes del sujeto.

items.sentence: We have a meeting on 10 o'clock.
